build_OneCommonTeacher: build a OneCommonTeacher instance to load and serve the OneCommon reference resolution dataset for dialogue training
create_get_tag: create a function call to get_tag that extracts token values between XML-style tags from a token list
test_OneCommonTeacher_observe: test the OneCommonTeacher observe method to compute selection accuracy and referent exact match metrics
